en.headline: Customs seizes 5 million illicit cigarettes from high-powered speedboat
en.dek: A joint operation with mainland agencies intercepted a 16-metre boat fitted with six outboard engines off Chek Lap Kok; two mainland men were arrested.
body: Hong Kong Customs, working with Guangdong Provincial Public Security Department and mainland anti-smuggling units, intercepted a high-powered speedboat in waters northwest of Chek Lap Kok on Tuesday evening and seized about 5 million suspected illicit cigarettes.

The haul has an estimated market value of about HK$22 million and a duty potential of about HK$16.5 million. Two mainland men aged 30 and 36 were arrested on suspicion of violating the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance. Officers said the 16-metre vessel was fitted with six powerful outboard engines, capable of 40 to 50 knots, and was running without navigation lights when spotted heading towards Sha Chau.

Customs interceptors pursued the boat after it accelerated and tried to flee towards the boundary. After a roughly 10-minute chase, officers boarded the vessel safely and took control. A Customs senior inspector said it was the highest-powered smuggling speedboat successfully intercepted by the department in the past two years.

The case remains under investigation. Customs said it would continue to trace the source and destination of the cigarettes and did not rule out further arrests. From January to August this year the department had already seized about 96 million suspected illicit cigarettes in sea operations.

zh.headline: 海關截高速走私快艇檢500萬支私煙拘兩人
zh.dek: 聯同內地部門在赤鱲角西北水域截獲配備六副舷外引擎的16米快艇，市值約2,200萬元。
body: 香港海關聯同廣東省公安廳及內地海 dev關緝私部門，周二傍晚在赤鱲角西北水域截獲一艘高速走私快艇，檢獲約500萬支懷疑未完稅香煙，估計市值約2,200萬元，應課稅值約1,650萬元。
兩名分別30歲及36歲的內地男子涉嫌違反《應課稅品條例》被捕。涉案快艇長約16米，配備六副大馬力舷外引擎，最高時速可達40至50海里，發現時沒有亮起航行燈，正高速駛向沙洲方向。
海關人員要求停船檢查時，快艇加速逃逸，兩艘高速截擊艇追截約10分鐘後強行登船控制。港口及海域科高級督察表示，這是海關近兩年來首次成功截獲用作走私、速度最高的快艇。
案件仍在調查，海關會繼續追查私煙來源及去向，不排除有更多人被捕。海關指今年1至8月已在海上行動檢獲約9,600萬支懷疑走私香煙。
